summary.text: SVEMKO AS is a private limited company registered in Lonevåg, founded 2015-04-12. SVEMKO AS is registered for the production of metal products not elsewhere classified, and its statutory purpose covers the development, testing and production of metal products. The company may also participate in and hold ownership interests in other companies. Its main industry code is 25.990: manufacture of other fabricated metal products n.e.c.. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 49 537 211 NOK and the annual result was 12 549 512 NOK; operating income was up from 26 512 861 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 3 055 268 NOK in 2024 to 12 549 512 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 11 827 050 NOK in 2024 to 24 398 171 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is svemko.com, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube profiles. The registered employee count went from 12 on 2026-02-13 to 13 on 2026-09-15. Recent changes in the register: share capital set to 49 710 on 2026-10-28.
